title: Copy of Board Request as of 9/22
provenance: Excel export of a Google Sheet titled 'Copy of Board Request as of 9/22' (a copy of the sheet, owner not identified), supplied by the repository owner on 2026-10-13 together with the link above. The repository owner says it was shared on 2026-09-22. Not downloaded by an agent; not checked against a PPS-published copy. On 2026-10-13 the agent opened the Google Sheet in the owner's browser: the title, the tab list and the size of the '26-27 As of 9/23 Counts' tab (461 data rows) matched this file.
context: Appears to be the staff spreadsheet answering a Board question dated 9/21/26 in the Oct 1, 2026 Q&A tracker: 'a large spreadsheet' with current K-5 enrollment by school, program and grade, current 6-8 class counts, spring staffing allocations, a 'School Detail for ISR' tab and SPED supports on a 'SPED' tab [BB:14493920 p.35].

tabs.title_in_xlsx: School Detail wo ESL or SPED or
tabs.title_in_google_sheet: School Detail wo ESL or SPED or M98 or T1

notes: Cell values are the cached values saved in the export; formulas were not recalculated.

Excel converted grade spans such as '6-8', '9-12' and '1-8' to dates (2026-06-08, 2026-09-12, 2026-01-08). tabs/*.csv keep them as exported; analysis/data/enrollment_2026-27_sept_by_school.csv converts them back.
xlsx sheet names drop '/' and are cut to 31 characters, so they differ slightly from the Google Sheet tab names (see tabs[].title_in_google_sheet).
The Readme tab holds only a link to a Google Doc, which has not been archived.
